item.title: Video allegedly shows Michigan synagogue attacker buying $2K in fireworks days before truck rampage
item.summary: Ayman Mohamad Ghazali allegedly purchased $2,250 worth of fireworks before ramming a truck into Temple Israel synagogue in West Bloomfield, Michigan.

item.title: High school senior charged with 'random' murder after 68-year-old woman found dead in Massachusetts home
item.summary: Massachusetts teenager Anthony DeMayo, 18, was charged with murder in an alleged random attack that killed Janet Swallow, 68, in her Danvers home Thursday.

item.title: White House erupts over CNN report claiming Trump team underestimated Iran response on Hormuz
item.summary: The White House press secretary denied a CNN report claiming the Trump team was unprepared for the potential Iranian closure of the Strait of Hormuz, calling it "fake news."

item.title: Trump says US ‘obliterated’ military targets in strike on key Iranian oil hub: 'Powerful bombing raids'
item.summary: President Trump said the U.S. bombed Iran’s Kharg Island, a key Iranian oil export hub, and warned against interference in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: GOP lawmakers would strip citizenship from terrorists after attacks tied to naturalized citizens
item.summary: A spate of terror attacks by naturalized U.S. citizens has several Republican lawmakers calling for naturalized citizens to be stripped of their citizenship if they engage in terror.

item.title: Cuban president reveals talks with Trump admin as fuel blockade chokes domestic energy supply and economy
item.summary: Cuba confirmed talks with the Trump administration amid an economic crisis after Venezuela oil was cut off. President Miguel Díaz-Canel cites aim to resolve differences.

item.title: Manhunt for Louisiana man wanted in deadly crash who may have fled state or country continues into sixth month
item.summary: A manhunt continues for Louisiana man Manmeet Singh, 30, who was charged with vehicular manslaughter after allegedly killing Patricia Saidu, 21, in a wrong-way crash.

item.title: Travel agencies warn spring break tourists about Mexico safety risks after recent surge of cartel violence
item.summary: Travel agencies advise heightened caution for Mexico trips as cartel conflicts created temporary violence spikes in popular resort regions last month, with safety varying significantly by state.

item.title: Man accused of attacking TSA officers, seriously injuring Dallas cop at airport
item.summary: A California man faces 20 years in prison after allegedly assaulting TSA officers and injuring a Dallas police officer at Love Field Airport in a violent incident.

item.title: Trump welcomes PRCA, WPRA champions at White House in return of rodeo tradition
item.summary: Rodeo buckle winners visited the White House for the first time in more than four decades when President Donald Trump hosted PRCA and WPRA world champions.
